page_title: RAY 1-1 CEL | Rayo Vallecano v Celta Vigo 21/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Victor Garcia has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
90+6' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

90+5' Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) rises above the defence to meet a cross from the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
90+5' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is about to take a corner kick.
90+3' Celta Vigo are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
90+1' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch so that Pedro Diaz can be given a rest.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samuel Becerra (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch for Jorge de Frutos.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The resulting corner, taken by Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo), comes to nothing.

89' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the right side of the goal, but great anticipation by Augusto Batalla allowed him to make a comfortable save. Celta Vigo will take a corner kick.
89' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) launches a cross from the corner, but Augusto Batalla is alert to thwart the effort.
88' Neat passing move from Rayo Vallecano in order to create new attacking opportunities.
86' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

85' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo will have a chance to score from a corner.
85' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
84' Lovely run from Alemao (Rayo Vallecano). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
83' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
82' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
80' 60:40 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
79' Here is a change. Bryan Zaragoza is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo).
79' Claudio Giraldez is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) suffers an injury and Carl Starfelt comes on.
76' A cross from a corner kick by Rayo Vallecano is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

76' Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the top left corner. However, Ionut Radu anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. Rayo Vallecano have a corner.
74' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The linesman signals a throw-in for Celta Vigo.
71' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) replaces Hugo Sotelo.
68' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
68' Substitution. Isi Palazon leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano).
65' 1 - 1 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) unleashes a shot straight inside the left post. Good team effort!
65' Victor Garcia blows the whistle, Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for a foul.
63' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
60' The manager makes a subsitution with Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) coming on for Sergio Camello.
60' Hugo Alvarez will be replaced by Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo).
60' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Pacha will be replaced by Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Javier Rueda trots off the pitch and is replaced by Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo).
59' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball has crossed the sideline. Rayo Vallecano are taking a throw-in.
58' The Celta Vigo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
55' Today's referee Victor Garcia rightly decides to book Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) for his harsh tackle.
55' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
54' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 9:7.

49' 0 - 1 Hugo Alvarez produces a cross from the resulting corner and finds Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) inside the box. He pulls the trigger and scores, sending the ball inside the right post. What a brilliant finish. 0:1.
49' The ball is out of play and Celta Vigo manage to earn a corner.

49' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the bottom right corner, but Augusto Batalla made a superb athletic save to deny him.

48' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He creates some space for the shot, but blazes it high over the crossbar. Very bad attempt. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
47' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and produces a ferocious strike towards the left post, but his shot is well held by the goalkeeper.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' A lofted cross from Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

45+1' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' The percentage of ball possession is – 59:41.
41' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Celta Vigo, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
40' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Victor Garcia didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
39' Rayo Vallecano seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
35' Ionut Radu (Celta Vigo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
34' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
33' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
28' A cross from Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
26' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) tackles a bit over-zealously and Victor Garcia blows for a foul.
22' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Augusto Batalla, who smothers the ball.

21' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.

21' Ambitious effort from Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.

19' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
18' Manuel Fernandez (Celta Vigo) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.

16' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.

13' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
11' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Celta Vigo comes to nothing.

11' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Celta Vigo earn a corner.
11' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
9' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Augusto Batalla is alert and denies him.
7' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Pacha (Rayo Vallecano).

6' The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick. Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
4' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
3' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Celta Vigo.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Victor Garcia will referee today's match.
